craft_notes: Sthāyin: skyless-entry (five attributes, then mind placed in outer sky enters the skyless). Rows: row 3 (made→enters). Close: enters (viśet — entry-verb refrain). Rejected: 'infinite sky' — killed: skyless kept (the SKY missing, stronger than empty); 'merges' — killed: enters kept (moves inward, not dissolves).

lines: mind in outer sky made — into skyless enters.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nitye nirāśraye śūnye vyāpake kalanojjhite | bāhyākāśe manaḥ kṛtvā nirākāśaṃ samāviśet
